about: Openly licensed photos of real, non-famous adults (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA), cut out and greyscale, credited one by one in credits.json.
stages: Each face is one fictional person with an ordered list of images by age (stages); the game shows the last stage whose min_age is at or below the person's age. Stock photos have one stage each (min_age 0). See faces.py.
